description: The plot illustrates the relationship between evaluation perplexity and the activated parameters ratio for four different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" and features a linear scale that decreases from left to right, ranging from 100 to 25 with tick marks at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL." and uses a linear scale ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick marks spaced every 0.5 units. The "Transformer" configuration is represented by a dashed red line without markers, showing a steady linear increase from approximately 11.7 at an x-value of 100 to roughly 13.0 at an x-value of 25. The "Only MoHD FFN" configuration is depicted by a solid grey line with square markers, starting at approximately 11.6 at x=100, rising gradually to 12.3 at x=50, and ending at roughly 13.2 at x=25. The "Only MoHD ATTN" configuration is shown as a solid dark blue line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 11.6 at x=100, increasing to 12.2 at x=75, and then rising sharply to 13.3 at x=50 before extending beyond the upper limit of the y-axis (above 14.0) at x=25. Finally, the "MoHD ATTN + MLP" configuration is represented by a solid light blue line with 'x' markers, starting at approximately 11.6 at x=100, increasing to 12.1 at x=75, reaching 13.0 at x=50, and ending at roughly 14.3 at x=25.
